kicker: Claude Code's sandbox, from the source

scenes.headline: How Claude Code boxes a shell command
scenes.sub: Reading the open-source sandbox runtime from its code
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Gimlet! Today, how the sandbox behind Claude Code's shell boxes a command.

scenes.text: The whole Linux sandbox is one bubblewrap command line: a mount table that decides every file, and a network namespace empty but for one socket to a proxy.
scenes.say: The whole Linux sandbox is one command line. Mounts decide every file. The network is empty, except one socket to a proxy.

scenes.title: The mount table is the policy

steps.say: First, the whole host disk is mounted read only. Reads are open; writes are refused.
The project folder is bound back on top, writable. Writes land only here.
Then the files that run code later, shell startup files and git hooks, are frozen on top.
A secret folder gets an empty mount over it. Its files are not hidden. They are gone.

scenes.title: What runs the command last
scenes.say: The network is removed; a helper runs the command one level down.

items.say: A relay starts inside the box, the only path to the proxy.
It waits until the relay is listening, so the command never races it.
A helper nests fresh namespaces, so the command cannot see the processes around it.
A kernel filter blocks local sockets, so the command cannot slip past the network fence.
A second filter refuses unsharing and mounting, so the command cannot undo its denials. Then it runs.

scenes.title: The shape, in Anthropic's own diagram

steps.say: A write outside the project and a denied host both fail; a write to the project is allowed.
Every connection leaves through a socket to the proxy, which allows a known host and asks about a new one.

scenes.label: added to each sandboxed command
scenes.say: On my machine, the sandbox added about eighty six milliseconds a command, against six without it.

scenes.text: You can read the whole boundary in one command line: mounts for the files, one socket for the network.

recap: The network is one proxy socket
A filter blocks the side doors
scenes.say: Mounts for the files. One socket for the network. A filter for the side doors.
